title: Trabzonspor fans expect win in Diyarbakır
seoTitle: Trabzonspor supporters expect victory over Amedspor
subtitle: The Trendyol Süper Lig match raises expectations of a win and goals from Salah and Onuachu.
excerpt: The match between Amed Sportif Faaliyetler and Trabzonspor in the Trendyol Süper Lig takes place today.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Amed Sportif Faaliyetler and Trabzonspor in the 3rd round of the Trendyol Süper Lig is the day's highlight and excites supporters. The match, scheduled for today at 21:30 at the Diyarbakır Stadium, generates great anticipation, especially among Trabzonspor fans. They expect a victory for their team and point to Mohamed Salah and Paul Onuachu as potential scorers.

The big game in Diyarbakır

Trabzonspor is preparing to face Amed Sportif Faaliyetler today at 21:30 in the Diyarbakır Stadium. This duel counts for the 3rd week of the Trendyol Süper Lig, and the city of Diyarbakır welcomes fans from various regions to watch the event.

Expectations of Trabzonspor supporters

Trabzonspor supporters, known as the “bordo‑blues”, voiced their hopes before the match. The general expectation is a win for Trabzonspor, securing the three points on offer. A fan traveling from Bursa, part of a group of about 30 people, said: “Umaro kazanacağız e tribünün hakkını vereceğiz. Skor tahminim 3-1. Beraberlik istemiyorum, umaro kazanırız.” Other fans from Trabzon also expect a clear victory.

Salah and Onuachu in the spotlight

Mohamed Salah and Paul Onuachu are the most mentioned names by fans as potential goal‑scorers. Many supporters hope Onuachu will “break his goal drought” and “return to his old form.” A Trabzon fan stated: “3-0 diyorum. Golleri de iki tane Salah, bir tane Onuachu atar. Onuachu’nun artık gol orucunu bozmasını bekliyoruz.” Mohamed Salah’s quality is described as “undisputed,” and the squad is considered “very good overall.”

Fan caravan and a message of unity

Trabzonspor fans traveled from different cities, such as Trabzon and Bursa, to watch the game in Diyarbakır. A supporter residing in Diyarbakır highlighted the importance of camaraderie: “First, may friendship win. We live in Diyarbakır. We want it to be a beautiful match.” He also wished success to both teams. Other fans expressed the excitement of arriving in Diyarbakır, with one saying: “With very intense emotions, we arrived in Diyarbakır. God willing, we’ll take the three points and return to our city safe and sound. For us, everywhere is Trabzon.”

Score predictions and optimism

Score predictions among Trabzonspor fans point to victories of 3-0 and 3-1. Confidence in the team is high, and there is hope for a strong performance from the attackers. One fan summed up the expectation: “I support Trabzonspor. Salah scores the first goal. Let it be a good game, I want us to win.”

With information from Günebakış Gazetesi Trabzon.
